1	/**
2	 * The record of the localize round: the first migrated TinyTranslator artifact
3	 * that mounts in a browser.
4	 *
5	 * Every number here is read at the moment the record is written — the build
6	 * logs, the two emitted inventories, the installed closure's own lockfile, and
7	 * a browser load of the canonical output root performed by this driver rather
8	 * than pasted from a previous one. This record supersedes u17d by reference:
9	 * u17d's bytes are unchanged and remain the record of the lane it measured,
10	 * whose artifact threw before Angular bootstrapped.
11	 */
12	
13	import { mkdir, readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
14	import * as path from 'pathe';
15	import { canonical, sha256 } from './angular-factoriolab-migration-run.ts';
16	import {
17		sealRecord,
18		verifySealedRecord,
19		type SealedRecord,
20	} from './angular-factoriolab-build-lanes-run.ts';
21	import { CONSENT } from './angular-tiny-translator-lanes-run.ts';
22	import { EVIDENCE_DIRECTORY, STAGE_DIRECTORY } from './angular-tiny-translator-apply-run.ts';
23	import { inventoryOf } from './angular-tiny-translator-final-record.ts';
24	import { observeAngularTinyTranslatorBoot } from '../witness/angular-tiny-translator-boot-check.ts';
25	import type { LocalizeRound } from './angular-tiny-translator-localize-run.ts';
26	
27	export const UNIT = 'lrapr-t006/u19f-localize-boot-green';
28	export const LOCALIZE_LANE_FILE = 'u19f-localize-boot-green-lane.json';
29	/** The output root this lane publishes, and the sibling that makes it canonical. */
30	export const CANONICAL_ROOT = 'dist-11';
31	export const REPEATED_ROOT = 'dist-12';
32	
33	type LockfilePackage = Readonly<{
34		version?: string;
35		resolved?: string;
36		integrity?: string;
37	}>;
38	
39	/** The registry facts behind one installed package, read from the lockfile. */
40	export async function readAcquiredPackage(
41		tree: string,
42		name: string,
43	): Promise<Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>> {
44		const lock = JSON.parse(await readFile(path.join(tree, 'package-lock.json'), 'utf8')) as {
45			packages?: Record<string, LockfilePackage>;
46		};
47		const entry = lock.packages?.[`node_modules/${name}`];
48		if (entry === undefined) throw new Error(`TinyTranslator localize record: ${name} not installed`);
49		return Object.freeze({
50			name,
51			version: entry.version ?? 'unknown',
52			url: entry.resolved ?? 'unrecorded',
53			integrity: entry.integrity ?? 'unrecorded',
54		});
55	}
56	
57	async function readBuild(index: number): Promise<Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>> {
58		const exit = await readFile(path.join(STAGE_DIRECTORY, `build-${String(index)}.exit`), 'utf8');
59		const log = await readFile(
60			path.join(STAGE_DIRECTORY, `build-${String(index)}.stdout.log`),
61			'utf8',
62		);
63		return Object.freeze({
64			name: `build-${String(index)}`,
65			exitStatus: Number.parseInt(exit.trim(), 10),
66			command: 'npx ng build --configuration production',
67			outputRoot: `dist-${String(index)}`,
68			bundleLines: log.split('\n').filter((line) => line.includes('.js')).length,
69		});
70	}
71	
72	export async function buildLocalizeLaneRecord(): Promise<SealedRecord> {
73		const round = JSON.parse(
74			await readFile(path.join(STAGE_DIRECTORY, 'localize-round.json'), 'utf8'),
75		) as LocalizeRound;
76		const builds = [await readBuild(11), await readBuild(12)];
77		const first = await inventoryOf(path.join(STAGE_DIRECTORY, CANONICAL_ROOT));
78		const second = await inventoryOf(path.join(STAGE_DIRECTORY, REPEATED_ROOT));
79		const identical = canonical(first) === canonical(second);
80		const acquired = await readAcquiredPackage(
81			path.join(STAGE_DIRECTORY, 'app'),
82			'@angular/localize',
83		);
84		const boot = await observeAngularTinyTranslatorBoot(path.join(STAGE_DIRECTORY, CANONICAL_ROOT));
85		return sealRecord({
86			schemaVersion: 'versionless.angular-tiny-translator-localize-lane.v1',
87			unit: UNIT,
88			consentId: CONSENT,
89			result: boot.booted
90				? 'localize-runtime-declared-build-green-deterministic-and-the-application-mounts'
91				: 'localize-runtime-declared-and-the-application-still-does-not-mount',
92			meaning:
93				'u19e left the migrated bundle throwing `$localize is not defined` at bootstrap. The ' +
94				"cause is a compiler change the migration crossed: this application's templates are " +
95				'i18n-marked, the era compiler substituted translations into the factories it emitted, ' +
96				'and the Angular 16 compiler emits `$localize` tagged templates the bundle evaluates at ' +
97				'run time. A capability reads the markers out of the templates themselves, declares ' +
98				"`@angular/localize` at the target cell's own range, and declares the entry point the " +
99				"package publishes for the pre-`main` position through the builder's own polyfills " +
100				'seam. The production build is green and byte-stable over two runs, and a browser load ' +
101				'of the canonical output root reaches the home surface: the application mounts and ' +
102				'renders its own title. This is the first migrated artifact of this cell that does.',
103			capability: {
104				name: 'template-i18n-runtime',
105				package: '@versionless/angular',
106				answers:
107					'the runtime half of an i18n-marked template on an Ivy-era line: the markers compile ' +
108					'to `$localize` tagged templates, and nothing in the framework runtime binds that global',
109				mechanism:
110					"The markers are read out of the compiler's own parse of each template — `i18n` on an " +
111					'element, `i18n-<attribute>` on one of its attributes — rather than out of a substring ' +
112					'search that would find comments and unrelated names. An application with no marker ' +
113					'gets nothing declared, because a polyfill nothing asks for is bundle weight and a ' +
114					'claim the templates contradict. A cell on a pre-Ivy line is refused for the same ' +
115					'reason: that compiler substitutes translations and emits no tagged template. The ' +
116					"version is the cell's own `@angular/` family range, never one this capability picks, " +
117					'and a cell that carries no range is refused rather than guessed at. Delivery is the ' +
118					"builder's `polyfills` list, the seam it already uses for a module the document has " +
119					'to evaluate before `main`.',
120				markersRead: round.declaration.reading.markers.length,
121				markedTemplates: round.declaration.reading.markedTemplates,
122				templatesRead: round.declaration.reading.templatesRead,
123				declaredDifferences: round.declaration.declaredDifferences,
124				refusedHere: [...round.declaration.unhandled, ...round.workspaceUnhandled],
125			},
126			applied: {

128				filesChanged: round.filesChanged,
129				dependencyChange: round.declaration.change,

152				runs: 2,

157			},

160			repeatedRoot: REPEATED_ROOT,
161			inventory: first,
162			boot: {

164				url: boot.url,
165				booted: boot.booted,

168				consoleErrors: boot.consoleErrors,
169				refusal: boot.refusal,
170				check: 'packages/cli/src/witness/angular-tiny-translator-boot-check.ts',

172			serviceWorkerAttempt: {
173				state: 'measured-era-defect-carried-across-the-migration',
174				attempted: true,
175				script: '%BASE_HREF%ngsw-worker.js',
176				httpStatus: 400,
